Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the age comparison. Despite correctly identifying the directors and their birth years (Lyudmil Kirkov: 1933; William Witney: 1915), the Planner concluded that The Boy Turns Man’s director is older, which contradicts the data. William Witney (1915) is older than Lyudmil Kirkov (1933), so A Strange Adventure has the older director.
